The '''Shifalan patrol ship''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Shifala]] people of the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]].

==History==
A vessel of this type was used to capture the [[AG-37's freighter|freighter]] belonging to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[AG-37]].<ref name="L3POTFW" />
